• The given passage is regarding the art of carpet making.
 
• Now, **the blank 2 will explain how the history of carpet making can be connected with the Mughal era.**
 
• **Thus, among the given options, the correct word to use is "traced."** 
 
 
• "Traced" means to follow or track the path or development of something.(पता लगाया)
 
• Example: "The detective traced the suspect's movements on the night of the crime."
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of finding or discovering something.
